title: Sheaf Hom applied to a finite presentation is a kernel of finite sums
statement:
Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and let $\mathcal E_2\xrightarrow{a}\mathcal E_1\xrightarrow{b}\mathcal E\to0$ be an exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For any source module $\mathcal H\in\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ and target module $\mathcal M\in\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$, applying the sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom] contravariantly in the source gives an exact sequence
$$0\longrightarrow\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal E,\mathcal M)\xrightarrow{b^*}\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal E_1,\mathcal M)\xrightarrow{a^*}\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal E_2,\mathcal M).$$
In particular, for a finite presentation $\mathcal O_X^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal H\to0$, the identifications $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal O_X,-)\cong\operatorname{id}$ and compatibility with finite direct sums give an exact sequence
$$0\longrightarrow\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal H,\mathcal M)\longrightarrow\mathcal M^{\oplus n}\longrightarrow\mathcal M^{\oplus m}.$$ 
This is Modules, Lemma 01CO(1),(2).

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01CO(1),(2) (left exactness of internal Hom), and the Internal Hom discussion immediately preceding it (Hom$(\mathcal O_X,-)=\operatorname{id}$ and finite direct sums)

mathlib_searches.query: sheaf Hom of modules is left exact in the first variable and commutes with finite direct sums
mathlib_searches.results: SheafOfModules.Hom and AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Hom are only Hom types; CategoryTheory.sheafHom is Type-valued for sheaves in a fixed category. No module-valued sheaf-Hom exactness result.
SheafOfModules.Hom is the type of module morphisms, CategoryTheory.sheafHom is Type-valued, and ShortComplex.isIso_of_isIso is unrelated to the module-valued internal Hom statement.

Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/SheafHom.lean provides only Type-valued sheafHom; Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf has no module-valued internal Hom or left-exactness theorem; finite direct-sum Hom for sheaves is absent.

split_report.summary: Corrected the variance of the internal-Hom kernel statement: for an exact source sequence E₂→E₁→E→0 and target M, Hom(E,M)→Hom(E₁,M)→Hom(E₂,M) is exact; the finite-presentation specialization now uses source H and target M with M^n→M^m.
